title: Establishing a Morning Routine That Actually Works
paragraphs: After reading numerous articles about the benefits of structured morning routines, Feri attempted to adopt an elaborate hour-long routine involving exercise, journaling, and meditation, abandoning it entirely after less than a week of exhausted attempts.

Rather than concluding that morning routines simply did not work for him, Feri experimented with a considerably shorter version, retaining only the two elements he found genuinely valuable rather than the complete list borrowed from articles.

This scaled-down routine, consisting of just ten minutes of quiet reflection and a short walk, proved sustainable in a way the elaborate version never had, fitting realistically into his actual daily constraints.

A year later, Feri maintains this modest routine consistently, having learned that a simple, sustainable habit produced far more lasting benefit than an impressive but ultimately unsustainable routine copied entirely from someone else's life.
